Secondary school teachers · in French

Class manager

For secondary school teachers in France with several classes and groups: marks entered in seconds (keyboard or phone), any scale converted to 20, weighting, absent / not marked / exempt never counted, an optional bonus test that only counts if it raises the average, class statistics (average, median, range, distribution), skills on the four-level scale of the French national curriculum (source and check date shown), a bank of report-comment phrases to combine and edit, printable report cards and CSV export. Pupils are recorded by first name and initial or a pseudonym only. A personal preparation tool, not a replacement for the school's official system.
